places.name: The Bund (Waitan)
places.ai_summary: A famous waterfront area in central Shanghai, offering stunning views of the city’s skyline and historic colonial buildings.

opening_hours.notes: Evenings are ideal for the illuminated skyline.

places.place_tip: Take a river cruise for a unique perspective.
places.address: Zhongshan East 1st Rd, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

places.name: Oriental Pearl Tower
places.ai_summary: An iconic TV tower featuring observation decks, a revolving restaurant, and a history museum at its base.

opening_hours.notes: Evenings offer the best views of the city lights.

places.place_tip: Visit the glass-bottomed skywalk for a thrilling experience.
places.address: 1 Century Ave, Pudong, Shanghai, China

attribution.title: Oriental Pearl Tower in Shanghai
attribution.author: Dmitry A. Mottl
attribution.description: Oriental Pearl Tower in Shanghai, China

places.name: Yu Garden
places.ai_summary: A classical Chinese garden featuring pavilions, ponds, rockeries, and lush greenery, offering a tranquil escape in the city.

opening_hours.notes: Arrive early to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with a stroll through the nearby bazaar.
places.address: 218 Anren St, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

attribution.title: Shanghai - Yu Garden - 0035
attribution.author: Stefan Fussan
attribution.description: Tingtao Tower Exhibit Hall and a pond in Yu Garden, Shanghai, China

places.name: Nanjing Road
places.ai_summary: A bustling shopping street in Shanghai, known for its vibrant atmosphere, luxury boutiques, and local shops.

opening_hours.notes: Best experienced in the evening when the lights are on.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the street performances and food stalls.
places.address: Nanjing Rd, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

places.name: Shanghai Tower
places.ai_summary: The tallest building in China and the second tallest in the world, featuring a unique twisting design and an observation deck with panoramic city views.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry to the observation deck is at 21:00.

places.place_tip: Book a ticket for the glass floor experience.
places.address: 501 Yincheng Middle Rd, Lujiazui, Pudong, Shanghai, China

places.name: Jade Buddha Temple
places.ai_summary: A famous Buddhist temple in Shanghai, known for its two magnificent jade Buddha statues and beautiful architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Maintain silence and respect the religious practices.

places.place_tip: Participate in a tea ceremony if offered.
places.address: 170 Anfu Rd, Xuhui District, Shanghai, China

attribution.title: (2024) Mahavira Hall, Jade Buddha Temple, Shanghai - img 04
attribution.author: Chainwit.
attribution.description: Mahavira Hall, Jade Buddha Temple, Shanghai

places.name: Tianzifang Art District
places.ai_summary: A trendy arts and crafts enclave in the French Concession, featuring narrow alleys, traditional Shikumen houses, and a variety of shops and galleries.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the area on foot to fully appreciate the art and culture.

places.place_tip: Check out the local cafes and street art.
places.address: Tianzifang, 274 Taikang Rd, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

attribution.title: Shanghai Tianzifang 上海田子坊 - panoramio
attribution.author: lienyuan lee

places.name: Shanghai Disney Resort
places.ai_summary: A world-class entertainment resort featuring themed hotels, a large shopping district, and the famous Shanghai Disneyland Park.

opening_hours.notes: Check the official website for the parade and fireworks schedule.

places.place_tip: Download the Disney app for the latest updates and wait times.
places.address: Shanghai Disneyland, 310 Huangzhao Rd, Pudong, Shanghai, China

places.name: People’s Square & Museum
places.ai_summary: A large public square in the city center, home to the Shanghai Museum, Shanghai Urban Planning Exhibition Center, and the Grand Theatre.

opening_hours.notes: The square is open 24 hours, but the museums have specific visiting hours.

places.place_tip: Visit the Shanghai Museum for its impressive collection of Chinese art and artifacts.
places.address: People’s Square, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

attribution.title: People Square seen from Urban Planning Exhibition Center
attribution.author: Jordiferrer
attribution.description: People Square seen from the Urban Planning Exhibition Center

places.name: Zhujiajiao Water Town
places.ai_summary: An ancient water town with well-preserved architecture, charming canals, and a history dating back to the Ming and Qing dynasties.

opening_hours.notes: Take bus 17 or 18 from Shanghai to reach the town.

places.place_tip: Try the local snacks and visit the ancient temples.
places.address: Zhujiajiao, Qingpu District, Shanghai, China

places.name: Shanghai French Concession
places.ai_summary: A historic area in Shanghai with tree-lined avenues, colonial architecture, and a vibrant mix of shops, cafes, and galleries.

opening_hours.notes: Explore on foot or by bike for a leisurely experience.

places.place_tip: Visit the local boutiques and enjoy a coffee at a sidewalk cafe.
places.address: Shanghai French Concession, Shanghai, China

places.name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
places.ai_summary: A large public aquarium in Shanghai, featuring a wide variety of marine life, underwater tunnels, and interactive exhibits.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry is one hour before closing.

places.place_tip: Don’t miss the underwater tunnel and the panda exhibit.
places.address: 1388 Lujiazui Ring Rd, Pudong, Shanghai, China

places.name: Xintiandi Shopping Area
places.ai_summary: A stylish pedestrian street in the French Concession, known for its upscale shops, restaurants, and nightlife.

opening_hours.notes: Great place for dining and entertainment in the evening.

places.place_tip: Explore the side streets for unique boutiques and art galleries.
places.address: Xintiandi, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

places.name: Longhua Temple
places.ai_summary: The largest ancient temple complex in Shanghai, known for its stunning architecture, beautiful gardens, and the famous Longhua Pagoda.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the religious practices and maintain silence.

places.place_tip: Climb the pagoda for a panoramic view of the area.
places.address: 2853 Longhua Rd, Xuhui District, Shanghai, China

places.name: Century Park
places.ai_summary: The largest park in the city, featuring beautiful landscapes, lakes, gardens, and various recreational facilities.

opening_hours.notes: Ideal for a morning jog or a leisurely stroll.

places.place_tip: Rent a bike to explore the park more efficiently.
places.address: 2000 Shiji Ave, Pudong, Shanghai, China

places.name: Qibao Ancient Town
places.ai_summary: An ancient water town in the suburbs of Shanghai, known for its well-preserved ancient buildings, traditional crafts, and local snacks.

opening_hours.notes: Try to visit on a weekday to avoid crowds.

places.place_tip: Taste the local delicacies and explore the ancient streets.
places.address: Qibao, Minhang District, Shanghai, China

places.name: Shanghai World Financial Center
places.ai_summary: A prominent skyscraper in Shanghai, known for its unique bottle opener shape and an observation deck with stunning views of the city.

opening_hours.notes: Last entry to the observation deck is at 21:00.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby Superbrand Mall for shopping and dining.
places.address: 100 Century Ave, Pudong, Shanghai, China

places.name: Fuxing Park
places.ai_summary: A beautiful public park in the French Concession, featuring traditional Chinese garden landscaping, pavilions, and a lake.

opening_hours.notes: A great place for a morning walk or tai chi.

places.place_tip: Visit the park’s small museum for insights into local history.
places.address: Fuxing Rd, Huangpu District, Shanghai, China

attribution.title: Fuxing Park, Shanghai
attribution.author: Jpbowen
attribution.description: View in Fuxing Park, Shanghai, China.

places.name: Lu Xun Park
places.ai_summary: A scenic park in Shanghai, dedicated to the famous Chinese writer Lu Xun, featuring a museum, a lake, and beautiful gardens.

opening_hours.notes: Explore the park’s walking trails and enjoy the peaceful environment.

places.place_tip: Visit the Lu Xun Memorial Hall for a deeper understanding of the writer’s life.
places.address: 2288 Sichuan Rd N, Hongkou District, Shanghai, China

places.name: M50 Creative Park
places.ai_summary: A contemporary art district in Shanghai, home to numerous galleries, studios, and creative spaces, set in a former textile factory.

opening_hours.notes: Check for special exhibitions and events.

places.place_tip: Explore the various art galleries and enjoy a coffee at the creative cafes.
places.address: 50 Moganshan Rd, Putuo District, Shanghai, China
